subject: Next steps: Sentinel sandbox evaluation & integration milestones
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hughes <alex.hughes@sentinel.ai>, Priya Desai <pdesai@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + proposed sandbox eval scope and timeline

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a concrete set of next steps so we can kick off the sandbox evaluation on Monday: 

Recap (what we agreed)
- Goal: short sandbox "proof-of-fit" to validate latency, cost, and integration surface for real-time inference in your security alerts product.
- Success criteria (tentative):
  - p50 latency under 120ms for 256-token requests
  - end-to-end integration using our streaming API for alert enrichment
  - function/tool-calling to let models surface structured enrichment results into your triage UI
  - measurable cost per 1k tokens target (we discussed target ~$0.80/1k tokens for the staged workload)
- Timeline: 3-week sandbox (Mon 2028-02-27 start) with a mid-point demo the following week and acceptance at week 3.

Immediate asks we need from Sentinel to start:
1) A small sample of anonymized alert payloads (S3 link or shared Drive) for end-to-end tests.
2) Confirm preferred SDK language (we support Python/Node/Java); you mentioned Java on the call — please confirm.
3) Point of contact for network/VPC questions and SSO/KMS requirements.

What Redwood will deliver before start date:
- Provisioned sandbox tenant and API keys scoped to the evaluation account.
- Pre-built Java SDK snippets (streaming + function-calling) and a step-by-step integration checklist (attached).
- A proposed streaming route and example call patterns, plus recommended batching and KV cache parameters for your traffic profile.

Attachments: sandbox-integration-checklist.xlsx, mvp-success-criteria.md, redwood-sdk-snippets.zip

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute technical kickoff (we'll invite Neha and Ben) on Mon 2028-02-27 10:00 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into a sandbox and validating the fit.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0187

From: Alex Hughes <alex.hughes@sentinel.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <pdesai@sentinel.ai>
Date: 2028-02-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed sandbox eval scope and timeline

On Tue, Feb 20, 2028 at 09:12 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a concrete set of next steps so we can kick off the sandbox evaluation on Monday:

Thanks Rachel — that recap looks right and very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide an anonymized S3 bucket with 10k historical alert events by Friday. I'll share the link and a short schema doc.
- We prefer Java for the integration (internal infra is Java-based) and streaming is a must for low-latency enrichment.
- Priya will own security/SSO/KMS questions. Priya — we need SAML SSO + KMS integration details for keys.
- Can Redwood support canary routing so we can run a small % of real traffic through the sandbox later in week 2? We want to smoke-test in prod-like conditions.

One more ask: can you include an example of function/tool-calling that returns both a structured JSON enrichment object and a confidence score? That exact shape will make it easier to wire into our triage UI.

Attaching: governance_requirements.pdf (security checklist)

Alex
Head of Integrations, Sentinel Analytics
alex.hughes@sentinel.ai

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Hughes <alex.hughes@sentinel.ai>, Priya Desai <pdesai@sentinel.ai>
Date: 2028-02-20T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Recap + proposed sandbox eval scope and timeline — action items for SE/CS

Forwarding Alex's reply — Priya is looped for security items. Internal owners: please own the technical onboarding and sandbox provisioning. Key asks below.

Action items (please own & confirm ETA):
- Neha: provision sandbox tenant, create scoped API key(s), and enable streaming route. Add SSO/KMS gating placeholder until Priya confirms details.
- Ben: prepare onboarding doc for the trial owners at Sentinel, and setup the mid-point demo agenda + success metric dashboard.
- Both: add Java SDK snippets for streaming + function-calling into the sandbox repo and validate them against anonymized sample events (Alex will share S3 link).

Implementation notes / suggested approach:
1) Sandbox provisioning: single-tenant sandbox with usage cap and separate log retention window (30 days).
2) API surface: propose using POST /v1/generate/stream for streaming enrichment and POST /v1/generate/json for batch evaluation.
3) Function/tool-calling: enable functions in the model config and include an endpoint mapping that returns {"enrichment": {...}, "confidence": 0.92}.
4) Telemetry: include redwood-trace header for distributed tracing; send example spans to their tracing endpoint.
5) Cost controls: apply a per-request token cap and auto-throttle policy for canary traffic.

I attached the integration checklist and SDK bundle. Neha — if you can reply with a concise step-by-step plan by EOD Wed 2028-02-21 that lists owners, ETA, and any gating items (SSO/KMS), I'll convert that into the calendar invites and stage gating.

—
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Hughes <alex.hughes@sentinel.ai>, Priya Desai <pdesai@sentinel.ai>
Date: 2028-02-23T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap + proposed sandbox eval scope and timeline — technical plan and owners

Thanks — here's the technical onboarding plan and owners. I've kept ETA columns tight so we can start on 2028-02-27 as discussed.

High-level plan (owners & ETA)
- Sandbox tenant provisioning (Neha) — provisioned by 2028-02-24 18:00 PT. Deliverable: tenant id + scoped API keys.
- Java SDK snippets + sample app (Neha) — 2028-02-25 12:00 PT. Deliverable: repo link with streaming and function-calling examples.
- Sample-run with anonymized S3 data (Ben + Sentinel) — 2028-02-27 14:00 PT. Deliverable: mid-point demo recording and dashboard.
- Canary routing config (Neha) — 2028-03-02 09:00 PT. Deliverable: routing rule + traffic cap (initially 1% -> 5%).
- Acceptance test & metrics (Ben) — 2028-03-10 16:00 PT. Deliverable: acceptance doc with p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, functional correctness checks.

Implementation steps (technical detail)
1) Provision: create tenant, enable streaming endpoint POST /v1/generate/stream, create API keys with read/write scopes restricted to test models.
2) SDK: include an example Java streaming client (websocket-based fallback) and a blocking JSON client. Example snippet below (Java streaming simplified):

// Java pseudo-code snippet for streaming (included in repo)
// client connects to wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream?tenant=TENANT_ID
// includes header Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY> and X-Redwood-Trace

3) Function-calling: enable function schema in model config and map to internal enrichment service. Response contract: {"enrichment": {"entity": "user", "risk_score": 0.73, ...}, "confidence": 0.87 }

4) Telemetry & tracing: add X-Redwood-Trace header value; we will forward span IDs to their tracing collector URL (placeholder).

5) Security gating: awaiting Priya's SAML + KMS requirements. We will hold SSO activation behind a gating ticket; initial sandbox will use API keys only.

Acceptance criteria (to be shown in midpoint demo)
- Functional: function-calling returns expected JSON shape for 95% of sample events.
- Performance: p50 < 120ms for 256-token enrichment requests; p95 < 400ms.
- Stability: no more than 2% error rate over a 30-minute sustained run at target QPS.
- Cost: sample cost report estimating tokens/1k and projected monthly cost for pilot.

Next steps
- Alex / Priya: share S3 link + security doc by EOD Fri 2028-02-24.
- Rachel: send calendar invites for Mon 2028-02-27 kickoff and Wed 2028-03-06 midpoint demo.

I've pushed the initial Java snippets and checklist to the sandbox repo: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_SENTINEL_SANDBOX_DOCS (files: redwood-sdk-snippets.zip contains the sample app).

If anything changes on the security gating side, flag it immediately so we can adjust the timetable.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
